title: Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility with Multivariate Fractional Brownian Motion
title_primary: Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility with Multivariate Fractional Brownian Motion
authors: Markus Bibinger, Jun Yu, Chen Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A multivariate fractional Brownian motion (mfBm) with component-wise Hurst exponents is used to model and forecast realized volatility (RV). We investigate the interplay between correlation coefficients and Hurst exponents and propose a novel method to estimate model parameters, establishing its consistency and asymptotic normality. Additionally, we develop a time-reversibility test, which is typically not rejected by RV data. When the data generating process is a time-reversible mfBm, we derive optimal forecasting formulae and analyze their properties. A key insight is that an mfBm with different Hurst exponents and non-zero correlations can reduce forecasting errors compared to a one-dimensional model. Consistent with this theory, out-of-sample forecasts using the time-reversible mfBm show improvements over univariate fBm, particularly when the estimated Hurst exponents differ significantly. Empirical results demonstrate that mfBm outperforms HAR and its variants in terms of out-of-sample forecast.

title: The Global (Mis)Allocation of Capital
title_zh: 全球资本的（错）配置
title_primary: 全球资本的（错）配置
title_secondary: The Global (Mis)Allocation of Capital
authors: Carol Bertaut, Stephanie E. Curcuru, Ester Faia, Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas
official: 官方在线 2025-12-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the efficiency of international capital flows into and out of the U.S. using security-level equity holdings matched to firm-level measures of economic performance from 1995 to 2022. We find that both US and foreign investors tilt their international equity portfolio toward the top of the firm distributions of Total Factor Productivity (TFP), mark-ups, Marginal Revenue Product of Capital (MRPK) and intangible capital. This allocation to the top occurs primarily through a between-firm component. For US firms with high initial productivity, and for foreign firms with high MRPK, increases in international investors’ equity holdings are associated with higher future investment in the near term.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1995年至2022年间证券层面的股权持有数据，与企业层面的经济绩效指标相匹配，研究了国际资本流入和流出美国的效率问题。我们发现，无论是美国投资者还是外国投资者，其国际股票投资组合均倾向于配置在全要素生产率（TFP）、加成率、资本边际收益产品（MRPK）及无形资本企业分布的前列。这种向顶端配置的现象主要通过企业间成分实现。对于初始生产率较高的美国企业以及MRPK较高的外国企业，国际投资者股权持有比例的增加与其短期内未来投资的增长相关联。

title: Selection Bias in Aid Effectiveness: Evidence From Aid for Trade and Foreign Direct Investment
title_zh: 援助有效性中的选择偏差：来自贸易援助与外国直接投资的证据
title_primary: 援助有效性中的选择偏差：来自贸易援助与外国直接投资的证据
title_secondary: Selection Bias in Aid Effectiveness: Evidence From Aid for Trade and Foreign Direct Investment
authors: Wonjun Choi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines whether Aid for Trade promotes foreign direct investment using bilateral panel data over 2005–2019. Conventional estimators show mixed results across donors, with no significant effects for Japanese aid. To address potential selection bias, we employ a Bartik‐style instrumental variable exploiting donor sectoral specialization and recipient revealed needs. The 2SLS estimates reveal substantial heterogeneity. Only Japanese AfT demonstrates strong causal effects, while other donors show no significant relationships when instrumented. The contrast between conventional and IV estimates suggests Japan systematically targets recipients with lower FDI potential, creating negative selection bias that masks true effects in conventional estimators. These findings highlight the importance of addressing endogeneity in aid effectiveness research and suggest donor strategies shape both aid allocation and outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2005年至2019年的双边面板数据，考察了“贸易援助”是否促进了外国直接投资。传统估计方法在不同捐助国间显示出混合结果，对日本援助未发现显著效应。为应对潜在的选择性偏差，我们采用了基于巴蒂克风格的工具变量，利用捐助国的部门专业化及受援国的显性需求。两阶段最小二乘估计揭示了显著的异质性。仅日本的贸易援助展现出强烈的因果效应，而其他捐助国在工具变量法下未显示出显著关系。传统估计与工具变量估计之间的对比表明，日本系统性地瞄准了外国直接投资潜力较低的受援国，造成了负向选择性偏差，在传统估计方法中掩盖了真实效应。这些发现强调了在援助有效性研究中处理内生性的重要性，并表明捐助国策略同时塑造了援助分配及其结果。

title: Wealth and inequality in Spanish America, from colonial rule to the eve of independence in Montevideo
title_zh: 从殖民统治到独立前夕：西班牙美洲的财富与不平等——以蒙得维的亚为例
title_primary: 从殖民统治到独立前夕：西班牙美洲的财富与不平等——以蒙得维的亚为例
title_secondary: Wealth and inequality in Spanish America, from colonial rule to the eve of independence in Montevideo
authors: Rebeca Riella Koifmann
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The present article employs probate records to analyse private wealth accumulation and distribution in Montevideo between 1760 and 1825. The results reveal four major findings. Firstly, there was a sustained rise in average wealth over time, even in the face of independence‐related wars. Secondly, asset portfolios became more complex and urban‐oriented. Thirdly, wealth inequality declined over the period under study. Finally, Montevideo exhibited relatively low levels of inequality in comparison with other contemporary global regions. The distribution of urban real estate and enslaved individuals, in particular, became more equitable, revealing a distinctive pattern of slave ownership. Notwithstanding these more general improvements, the top decile continued to accumulate significant fortunes. The findings are consistent with the importance of frontier conditions, institutional frameworks, and warfare for understanding distributive outcomes in this setting. The case of Montevideo highlights the historical contingency of inequality trajectories over time.
abstract_zh: 本文利用遗嘱认证记录，分析了1760年至1825年间蒙得维的亚的私人财富积累与分配情况。研究结果揭示了四大主要发现。首先，即便在独立战争期间，平均财富也呈现出持续增长的趋势。其次，资产组合变得更加复杂且偏向城市导向。第三，在所研究期间，财富不平等程度有所下降。最后，与同期全球其他地区相比，蒙得维的亚的不平等水平相对较低。特别是城市房地产和被奴役人口的分配变得更加公平，显示出一种独特的奴隶所有权模式。尽管存在这些总体改善，但最富有的十分之一人口仍持续积累巨额财富。这些发现与边疆条件、制度框架和战争对理解该地区分配结果的重要性相吻合。蒙得维的亚的案例凸显了不平等轨迹随时间变化的历史偶然性。

title: AI Agents and Prompt Engineering in Econometric Coding
title_zh: AI代理与提示工程在计量经济学编程中的应用
title_primary: AI代理与提示工程在计量经济学编程中的应用
title_secondary: AI Agents and Prompt Engineering in Econometric Coding
authors: Sebastian Galiani, Federico Ariel López, Raul A. Sosa
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how large language models write code for econometric analysis. We compare three dimensions of AI-assisted coding: statistical software (Stata, R, or Python), prompting (zero-shot versus few-shot), and the degree of agency, from a chatbot that writes a single script to an agent that executes and revises its own code. On a benchmark of applied econometric and statistical tasks, moving from the chatbot to the constrained agent raises task success from 74 to 96 percent, at about eight additional cents per run. For Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 through Codex, few-shot prompting improves the chatbot far more than the constrained agent, indicating that prompting and agency act as substitutes. For these models, differences across statistical software are sizeable under the chatbot but largely disappear under the constrained agent.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大型语言模型如何为计量经济学分析编写代码。我们比较了AI辅助编程的三个维度：统计软件（Stata、R或Python）、提示方式（零样本与少样本），以及代理程度，从生成单一脚本的聊天机器人到执行并修订自身代码的智能体。在一组应用计量经济学和统计任务的基准测试中，从聊天机器人转向受限智能体将任务成功率从74%提升至96%，每次运行成本仅增加约八美分。对于Claude Sonnet 4.6和通过Codex运行的GPT-5.4，少样本提示对聊天机器人的改进远大于受限智能体，表明提示与代理程度互为替代。对于这些模型，不同统计软件之间的差异在聊天机器人下显著，但在受限智能体下基本消失。

title: Unionized oligopoly and tax principles
title_zh: 工会化寡头垄断与税收原则
title_primary: 工会化寡头垄断与税收原则
title_secondary: Unionized oligopoly and tax principles
authors: Yen, Chih-Ta
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the interaction between labor-market institutions and commodity tax-base design in an open economy with imperfect competition. We develop a two-country Cournot model in which a domestic firm bargains over wages with a monopoly labor union, while the foreign firm operates under a competitive labor market. Governments choose commodity tax rates under either the destination or the origin principle. We show that the welfare effects of unionization are systematically tax-base dependent. Under the destination principle, consumption-based taxation does not correct the production distortion induced by union wage bargaining, placing the unionized country at a disadvantage. Under the origin principle, production-based taxation directly interacts with union-induced cost distortions, yielding regime-specific welfare outcomes that depend on trade costs and the competitive wage. The analysis highlights tax-base design as a key institutional margin shaping strategic interaction and welfare in unionized oligopolies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在不完全竞争的开放经济中，劳动力市场制度与商品税基设计之间的相互作用。我们构建了一个两国古诺模型，其中国内企业与垄断工会进行工资谈判，而外国企业则在竞争性劳动力市场下运营。各国政府在目的地原则或原产地原则下选择商品税率。研究表明，工会化的福利效应系统性地依赖于税基设计。在目的地原则下，基于消费的税收无法纠正工会工资谈判导致的生产扭曲，使工会化国家处于不利地位。在原产地原则下，基于生产的税收直接与工会引发的成本扭曲相互作用，产生取决于贸易成本和竞争性工资的特定制度福利结果。分析凸显了税基设计作为影响工会化寡头垄断中战略互动与福利的关键制度维度。

title: Demand for Safe Assets and Spillovers from the Global Dollar Cycle
title_zh: 安全资产需求与全球美元周期的溢出效应
title_primary: 安全资产需求与全球美元周期的溢出效应
title_secondary: Demand for Safe Assets and Spillovers from the Global Dollar Cycle
authors: Allen, Cian, Bems, Rudolfs, Boer, Lukas, Moussa, Racha
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: US dollar appreciations can inflict sizable negative cross-border spillovers. We investigate such spillovers from flight-to-safety shocks and the accompanying "global dollar cycleâ€ . Our results show that negative real sector spillovers from US dollar appreciations fall disproportionately on emerging markets. In contrast, effects on advanced economies are small and short-lived. Emerging market commodity exporters historically experienced larger negative spillovers than commodity importers, reflecting a strong negative link between the US dollar and commodity prices. In terms of policies, more anchored inflation expectations can mitigate the initial negative spillovers, while more flexible exchange rates can speed up the subsequent economic recovery.
abstract_zh: 美元升值可能引发显著的负面跨境溢出效应。本文研究了避险冲击及其伴随的"全球美元周期"所产生的此类溢出效应。研究结果表明，美元升值对实体经济的负面溢出效应不成比例地集中于新兴市场。相比之下，对发达经济体的影响则较小且短暂。历史上，新兴市场中的大宗商品出口国比进口国承受了更大的负面溢出效应，这反映了美元与大宗商品价格之间存在强烈的负相关关系。在政策层面，更稳固的通胀预期能够缓解初始阶段的负面溢出效应，而更灵活的汇率制度则有助于加速后续的经济复苏。

title: Floats, pegs and the transmission of fiscal policy
title_zh: 浮动汇率、固定汇率与财政政策的传导
title_primary: 浮动汇率、固定汇率与财政政策的传导
title_secondary: Floats, pegs and the transmission of fiscal policy
authors: Giancarlo Corsetti, Gernot Müller, Keith Kuester, Bernhard Bartels, Barry Eichengreen 等
official: 官方在线 2011-01-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper we reconsider the transmission of shocks to government spending across these regimes within a standard new-Keynesian model of a small open economy. Because of the stronger emphasis on intertemporal optimization, the new-Keynesian framework requires a precise specification of fiscal and monetary policies, and their interaction, at both short and long horizons. We derive an analytical characterization of the transmission mechanism of expansionary spending policies under a peg, showing that the long-term real interest rate necessarily rises if inflation rises on impact, in response to an increase in government spending. This drives down private demand even though short-term real rates fall. As this need not be the case under floating exchange rates, the conventional wisdom needs to be qualified. Under plausible medium-term fiscal policies, government spending is not necessarily less expansionary under floating exchange rates.
abstract_zh: 本文在标准的新凯恩斯小型开放经济模型中重新审视了不同汇率制度下政府支出冲击的传导机制。由于新凯恩斯框架更强调跨期优化，因此需要精确界定财政与货币政策及其在短期与长期内的相互作用。我们推导了钉住汇率制度下扩张性支出政策传导机制的分析特征，表明若政府支出增加导致通胀即时上升，长期实际利率必然随之攀升。尽管短期实际利率下降，这一效应仍会抑制私人需求。由于浮动汇率制度下未必出现此情形，传统观点需加以修正。在合理的中期财政政策条件下，浮动汇率制度下的政府支出未必具有更弱的扩张效应。

title: Functional specialization and wages in Europe
title_zh: 欧洲的功能专业化与工资
title_primary: 欧洲的功能专业化与工资
title_secondary: Functional specialization and wages in Europe
authors: Roman Stöllinger, Sandra M. Leitner, Zuzana Zavarska
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between functional specialization (FS) in global value chains (GVCs) and wages. Drawing on the GVC theory and intellectual monopoly capitalism theory, both highlighting asymmetries in international production and knowledge networks, it is postulated that FS in fabrication and FS in research and development (R&D) have differentiated effects on the evolution of wages. To test this hypothesis, we embed measures of FS in a structural wage regression and estimate the relationship for 25 EU countries over the period 2003–2022. We find some evidence for this hypothesis, notably a negative association between FS in fabrication and wages. Furthermore, we obtain partial confirmation of the expected patterns in our instrumental variable regressions, although the findings are not fully robust across all specifications.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球价值链（GVC）中的功能专业化（FS）与工资之间的关系。基于全球价值链理论与智力垄断资本主义理论（两者均强调国际生产与知识网络中的不对称性），本文提出假设：制造功能专业化与研发（R&D）功能专业化对工资演变具有差异化影响。为验证该假设，我们将功能专业化指标嵌入结构性工资回归模型，并对2003-2022年间25个欧盟国家进行估计。研究结果部分支持该假设，尤其发现制造功能专业化与工资呈负相关关系。此外，工具变量回归虽部分验证了预期模式，但该结论在所有模型设定中并非完全稳健。

title: Youth Crime and Delinquency In And Out Of School
title_zh: 青少年犯罪与逃学及在校行为
title_primary: 青少年犯罪与逃学及在校行为
title_secondary: Youth Crime and Delinquency In And Out Of School
authors: Janine Boshoff, Stephen Machin, Matteo Sandi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Ten years of idiosyncratic variation in school closure dates for all secondary schools in England are combined with administrative records of educational and criminal trajectories linked at the individual level to study the impact of the school schedule on the dynamics of youth crime. When school is not in session, students commit more property offences, more serious violent offences and fewer minor violent offences. Increased thefts, robberies and violent assaults drive these effects. This is novel evidence of strong multiple crime effects that arise from the protective factor of schooling and which affect not only the incidence of violence, but also its severity and its targets.
abstract_zh: 本文利用英格兰所有中学十年间因特殊原因导致的停课日期变化，结合个体层面关联的教育与犯罪轨迹行政记录，研究学校作息安排对青少年犯罪动态的影响。当学校停课时，学生实施的财产犯罪、严重暴力犯罪增加，而轻微暴力犯罪减少。盗窃、抢劫和暴力袭击的增加是导致这些效应的主要原因。本研究首次提供了强有力的多重犯罪效应证据，这些效应源于学校教育的保护性因素，不仅影响暴力犯罪的发生率，还影响其严重程度及目标对象。

title: Insurance with Multiple Actors
title_zh: 多方参与的保险
title_primary: 多方参与的保险
title_secondary: Insurance with Multiple Actors
authors: Jason Abaluck, Oren Sarig, Jintaek Song
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We analyze how social-planner insurers split cost-sharing between consumers and firms (e.g. patients and doctors, or drivers and car mechanics). With no contracting frictions, firm cost-sharing can replace consumer cost-sharing other than “visit copays.” Optimal firm contracts depend on the marginal rate of substitution between consumer and firm cost-sharing. For Medicare physician services, paying physicians more up front but less as spending increases reduces risk for both patients and providers; in our calibration, net benefits are twice those from eliminating Medigap externality. For prescription drugs, a dollar of physician paperwork costs is 45–110 times more impactful than a dollar of consumer cost-sharing.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了社会规划型保险公司如何在消费者与企业（例如患者与医生，或驾驶员与汽车修理工）之间分摊成本。在不存在契约摩擦的情况下，除"就诊共付额"外，企业成本分摊可替代消费者成本分摊。最优企业契约取决于消费者与企业成本分摊之间的边际替代率。以医疗保险医生服务为例，提高预付比例但降低随支出递增的支付比例，可同时降低患者与医疗服务提供者的风险；在我们的校准模型中，其净收益是消除医疗补充保险外部性收益的两倍。对于处方药而言，医生每增加一美元文书工作成本的影响，是消费者每增加一美元成本分摊的45至110倍。

title: Long-Run Efficiency with Local Interactions and Heterogeneous Types
title_zh: 局部互动与异质性类型下的长期效率
title_primary: 局部互动与异质性类型下的长期效率
title_secondary: Long-Run Efficiency with Local Interactions and Heterogeneous Types
authors: Erik Lillethun
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In evolutionary game theory, when a population of players with the same preferences may freely choose a location in which to interact with other players, previous literature has shown that long-run evolutionary forces select in favor of payoff-dominant equilibria. In this paper, I extend this location choice aspect of evolutionary game theory to the case of two different payoff types of players in 2 × 2 games. I show that whether or not payoff-dominant equilibrium selection occurs depends on the precise interaction of types, especially whether they exhibit mutual strategic homophily or a mix of homophily and heterophily. The former case guarantees payoff-dominant equilibria, and the latter case may not, because coordination becomes imperfect and may settle on an inefficient strategy.
abstract_zh: 在演化博弈论中，当具有相同偏好的玩家群体可以自由选择与其他玩家互动的地点时，既有文献表明，长期演化力量倾向于选择收益占优均衡。本文将演化博弈论中的这一地点选择方面扩展至2×2博弈中两类不同收益类型玩家的情形。我证明，收益占优均衡是否出现取决于类型间的精确互动，尤其是它们是否表现出相互的战略同质性，或是同质性与异质性的混合。前者保证收益占优均衡，而后者则未必，因为协调变得不完美，可能最终停留在低效策略上。

title: Tatonnement and Price Setting in General Equilibrium
title_zh: 一般均衡中的试探过程与价格设定
title_primary: 一般均衡中的试探过程与价格设定
title_secondary: Tatonnement and Price Setting in General Equilibrium
authors: Iván Werning, Guido Lorenzoni
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A foundational question in General Equilibrium theory—when is an equilibrium stable?—has remained largely unresolved for over 150 years despite important contributions. This paper proposes a resolution.
abstract_zh: 一般均衡理论中的一个基础性问题——均衡何时是稳定的？——尽管已有重要贡献，但在超过150年的时间里仍未得到根本解决。本文提出了一种解决方案。

title: Robust Design and Evaluation of Predictive Algorithms under Unobserved Confounding
title_zh: 未观测混杂下预测算法的稳健设计与评估
title_primary: 未观测混杂下预测算法的稳健设计与评估
title_secondary: Robust Design and Evaluation of Predictive Algorithms under Unobserved Confounding
authors: Ashesh Rambachan, Amanda Coston, Edward H. Kennedy
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Predictive algorithms inform consequential decisions in settings with selective labels: outcomes are observed only for units selected by past decision makers. This creates an identification problem under unobserved confounding — when selected and unselected units differ in unobserved ways that affect outcomes. We propose a framework for robust design and evaluation of predictive algorithms that bounds how much outcomes may differ between selected and unselected units with the same observed characteristics. These bounds formalize common empirical strategies including proxy outcomes and instrumental variables. Our estimators work across bounding strategies and performance measures such as conditional likelihoods, mean squared error, and true/false positive rates. Using administrative data from a large Australian financial institution, we show that varying confounding assumptions substantially affects credit risk predictions and fairness evaluations across income groups.
abstract_zh: 摘要 预测算法在存在选择性标签的情境中影响关键决策：仅当个体被过往决策者选中时，其结果才可观测。这会在未观测混杂因素存在时引发识别问题——即被选中与未被选中的个体在影响结果的未观测维度上存在差异。我们提出一个预测算法稳健设计与评估框架，通过界定具有相同可观测特征的被选中与未被选中个体之间结果差异的上限，将代理结果与工具变量等常见实证策略形式化。该框架的估计量适用于不同边界策略及条件似然、均方误差、真/假阳性率等性能指标。基于澳大利亚某大型金融机构的行政数据，我们证明混杂假设的差异会显著影响不同收入群体的信用风险预测与公平性评估。

title: What do news readers want?
title_zh: 新闻读者想要什么？
title_primary: 新闻读者想要什么？
title_secondary: What do news readers want?
authors: Gregory J. Martin, Shoshana Vasserman, Cameron Pfiffer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using a novel dataset covering the complete history of individual-level web traffic and digital subscriptions from a major metropolitan newspaper in the United States between 2020 and 2024, we investigate consumers' willingness to pay for different categories of news content, with particular focus on the kinds of coverage believed to generate civic externalities. Our identification strategy relies on the quasi-random arrival of paywall events which force consumers to subscribe if they wish to continue reading. Using this variation, we estimate a model of consumer demand and construct the optimal staff allocation for the paper under different counterfactual revenue models: a fully subscription-based model and a fully ad-supported model. Our results suggest that readers are willing to pay for local reporting, and that measures of demand based only on time-use substantially underestimate the value of “hard” news coverage on topics like local politics and public health. However, digital subscription revenues alone are insufficient to cover staff costs even at the highest revenue-generating sections of the paper. We use our model to estimate the subsidy required to expand the newspaper's production of investigative coverage.
abstract_zh: 利用一项涵盖2020至2024年间美国某大都市报纸个体层面网页浏览与数字订阅完整历史的新数据集，我们研究了消费者对不同类别新闻内容的支付意愿，尤其聚焦于被认为能产生公民外部性的报道类型。我们的识别策略依赖于付费墙事件的准随机出现——这些事件迫使消费者若想继续阅读则必须订阅。借助这一变化，我们估计了消费者需求模型，并在两种反事实收入模式下构建了报纸的最优人员配置：完全订阅制模式与完全广告支持模式。研究结果表明，读者愿意为本地报道付费，而仅基于时间使用量的需求测度会显著低估本地政治与公共卫生等“硬新闻”报道的价值。然而，即便在报纸收入最高的板块，仅凭数字订阅收入也不足以覆盖人员成本。我们利用模型估算了扩大报纸调查性报道生产所需的补贴额度。

title: Beyond top-down policymaking: Policymaker–landowner interaction promotes reforestation in a strategy game
title_zh: 超越自上而下的政策制定：策略游戏中政策制定者与土地所有者的互动促进再造林
title_primary: 超越自上而下的政策制定：策略游戏中政策制定者与土地所有者的互动促进再造林
title_secondary: Beyond top-down policymaking: Policymaker–landowner interaction promotes reforestation in a strategy game
authors: Simona Rödlach, Giacomo Vaccario, Clare Cooper, Jaboury Ghazoul, Ivan P. Novotny
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Scotland aims to achieve net-zero emissions by 2045, with afforestation and native woodland restoration as key strategies, targeting 25% woodland cover by 2050, or roughly 10,000 ha of new woodland annually. Much of this expansion depends on private landowners often supported by public subsidies. Yet landowners are often resistant to native woodland expansion on account of their prioritization of traditional land uses and perceived economic risks. Understanding the factors that influence landowner uptake is therefore crucial for designing effective policies. This raises the question: how does interaction between policymakers and landowners affect policy adoption? To provide insights on this, we developed a custom strategy game as an interactive socio-ecological model in which local stakeholders develop land and resource use strategies as estate owners, farmers, or policymakers. In the game setting, ‘landowners’ made decisions on land-related economic activities, while ‘policymakers’ enacted policies with potential impact on the ‘landowners’ activities. In-game landscape indicators tracked land use changes. Discussions among players were recorded with a microphone for later analysis. We showed that interactions during policy drafting between land managers and policymakers within the frame of the game modeling process are associated with higher adoption rates of proposed policies. This suggests that, under simplified experimental conditions, integrating stakeholder perspectives early in real-life policy formulation could enhance the effectiveness of reforestation strategies in Scotland by addressing both ecological and social barriers to successful implementation. More broadly, in regions where policy adoption is limited by low stakeholder engagement or misaligned incentives, accessible and engaging participatory approaches as represented by strategy games may foster more effective and widely supported environmental governance.
abstract_zh: 苏格兰旨在2045年前实现净零排放，将植树造林和原生林地恢复作为关键策略，目标是在2050年前实现25%的林地覆盖率，即每年新增约1万公顷林地。这一扩张在很大程度上依赖于通常获得公共补贴支持的私人土地所有者。然而，由于土地所有者优先考虑传统土地利用方式并感知到经济风险，他们往往对原生林地扩张持抵触态度。因此，理解影响土地所有者采纳行为的因素对于设计有效政策至关重要。这引出了一个问题：政策制定者与土地所有者之间的互动如何影响政策采纳？为深入探究此问题，我们开发了一款定制策略游戏，作为一种交互式社会生态模型，让当地利益相关者以庄园主、农民或政策制定者的身份制定土地和资源利用策略。在游戏设定中，“土地所有者”就土地相关经济活动做出决策，而“政策制定者”则颁布可能影响“土地所有者”活动的政策。游戏中的景观指标追踪了土地利用变化。玩家间的讨论通过麦克风记录以供后续分析。我们研究表明，在游戏建模过程的框架内，土地管理者与政策制定者在政策起草期间的互动与所提议政策的更高采纳率相关联。这表明，在简化的实验条件下，将利益相关者的观点早期融入现实政策制定中，可通过同时应对生态和社会障碍来增强苏格兰再造林策略的有效性。更广泛而言，在政策采纳受限于利益相关者参与度低或激励措施不匹配的地区，以策略游戏为代表的可及且参与性强的方法可能促进更有效且获得广泛支持的环境治理。

title: Aggregate productivity effect of labour and capital market distortions in Canada
title_zh: 加拿大劳动力与资本市场扭曲的总生产率效应
title_primary: 加拿大劳动力与资本市场扭曲的总生产率效应
title_secondary: Aggregate productivity effect of labour and capital market distortions in Canada
authors: Yu Chen, Trevor Tombe
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract How efficiently are workers, investment capital, and production distributed across firms in Canada? And how have they varied over time, across regions, and between sectors? To answer these questions, we present novel measures of the degree of resource misallocation over time and space using uniquely detailed firm‐level data (T2‐LEAP) between 2001 and 2015. We find the dispersion of marginal returns to both capital and labour across firms have increased significantly during this period, suggesting allocative efficiency is deteriorating. Using a rich but tractable multi‐sector model of heterogeneous firms, we find that had the misallocation of labour and capital not worsened over our period of analysis, aggregate Canadian productivity would be significantly higher. Worsening allocations between sectors alone accounts for approximately half of the widening productivity gap between Canada and the United States over this period.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在加拿大，工人、投资资本和生产在企业间的分配效率如何？这些效率随时间、地区和部门之间有何变化？为解答这些问题，我们利用2001年至2015年间独特详尽的企业层面数据（T2-LEAP），提出了衡量资源错配程度在时间和空间上的新指标。我们发现，在此期间，资本和劳动边际回报在企业间的离散度显著增加，表明配置效率正在恶化。通过一个丰富但易于处理的多部门异质性企业模型，我们发现，若在我们分析期间劳动和资本的错配未加剧，加拿大总体生产率将显著提高。仅部门间配置恶化一项，就大约解释了这一时期加拿大与美国之间生产率差距扩大的半数原因。

title: Pairwise Imitation and Tournament Graphs
title_zh: 成对模仿与锦标赛图
title_primary: 成对模仿与锦标赛图
title_secondary: Pairwise Imitation and Tournament Graphs
authors: Sung‐Ha Hwang, Philip R. Neary, Jonathan Newton, Ryoji Sawa
official: 官方在线 2026-02-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates strategic dynamics under the behavioral rule of pairwise interact and imitate (PII), which requires minimal information and emphasizes outperforming opponents in pairwise interactions. We characterize PII using weak tournament graphs and, for a broad class of dynamics, establish a one-shot stability result for stochastic stability. Applications include Cournot competition, strategic complements and substitutes, externalities, Nash demand games, and status-seeking contests. The analysis highlights the competing roles of spite effects and perturbations in favoring relative success versus efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在“两两互动与模仿”（PII）行为规则下的策略动态，该规则要求最少的信息，并强调在两两互动中超越对手。我们利用弱锦标赛图来刻画PII，并针对一类广泛的动态，建立了随机稳定性的单次稳定性结果。应用领域包括古诺竞争、策略互补与替代、外部性、纳什需求博弈以及地位追求竞赛。分析凸显了恶意效应与扰动在偏好相对成功与效率之间的竞争性作用。

title: Rural–urban disparities in body mass index of women: evidence from counterfactual decomposition methods
title_zh: 农村与城市女性体质指数差异：基于反事实分解方法的证据
title_primary: 农村与城市女性体质指数差异：基于反事实分解方法的证据
title_secondary: Rural–urban disparities in body mass index of women: evidence from counterfactual decomposition methods
authors: Md. Mohsan Khudri, Andrew Hussey, Ahmad Reshad Osmani
official: 官方在线 2025-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study explores rural–urban (RU) disparities in the body mass index (BMI) among women of childbearing age in Bangladesh using data from five rounds of the Bangladesh Demographic and Health Surveys (2004–2018). Employing Oaxaca-Blinder and quantile regression-based counterfactual decomposition methods, we quantify the contributions of socio-economic factors, healthcare access, fertility behaviours, and infrastructure to the BMI gap between rural and urban areas. Our findings indicate that socio-economic factors, particularly education and wealth, significantly explain the disparities, with infrastructure differences further aggravating these gaps. Results reveal that the gap widens at higher BMI quantiles, suggesting that targeted interventions in rural areas are crucial for addressing educational and infrastructural deficits. While women’s differential returns to education and wealth status substantially contribute to the RU gap, differences in the impacts of health behaviours on BMI serve to shrink the gap. These findings emphasize the importance of tailored policy strategies to reduce health inequalities in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用孟加拉国人口与健康调查五轮数据（2004-2018年），探讨了孟加拉国育龄妇女体重指数（BMI）的城乡差异。采用Oaxaca-Blinder及基于分位数回归的反事实分解方法，我们量化了社会经济因素、医疗保健可及性、生育行为及基础设施对城乡BMI差距的贡献。研究发现，社会经济因素，尤其是教育和财富，显著解释了这些差异，而基础设施差异进一步加剧了这些差距。结果显示，在较高的BMI分位数上，差距扩大，表明针对农村地区的定向干预对于解决教育和基础设施不足至关重要。尽管女性在教育和财富状况上的不同回报显著贡献于城乡差距，但健康行为对BMI影响的差异则有助于缩小这一差距。这些发现强调了制定针对性政策策略以减少发展中国家健康不平等的重要性。

title: Broadband Internet and the Stock Market Investments of Individual Investors
title_zh: 宽带互联网与个人投资者的股票市场投资
title_primary: 宽带互联网与个人投资者的股票市场投资
title_secondary: Broadband Internet and the Stock Market Investments of Individual Investors
authors: Hans K. Hvide, Tom G. Meling, Magne Mogstad, Ola Vestad, Per Östberg 等
official: 官方在线 2023-04-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the effects of broadband internet use on the investment decisions of individual investors. A public program in Norway provides plausibly exogenous variation in internet use. Our instrumental variables estimates show that internet use causes a substantial increase in stock market participation, driven primarily by increased fund ownership. Existing investors tilt their portfolios towards funds, thereby obtaining more diversified portfolios and higher Sharpe ratios, and do not increase their trading activity in stocks. Overall, access to high-speed internet seems to spur a "Democratization of finance", with individuals making investment decisions that are more in line with the advice from portfolio theory.
abstract_zh: 本文研究宽带互联网使用对个人投资者投资决策的影响。挪威的一项公共项目为互联网使用提供了合理的外生性变化。工具变量估计结果显示，互联网使用显著提高了股市参与率，这一增长主要由基金持有量的增加驱动。现有投资者将投资组合向基金倾斜，从而获得更分散的投资组合和更高的夏普比率，且并未增加股票交易活跃度。总体而言，高速互联网的接入似乎推动了“金融民主化”，使个人投资者做出的投资决策更符合投资组合理论的建议。
